limitations: Acceptance inputs only. Authoring tests validate their structure, not model compliance or production workflow behavior.

cases.setup: Start only from pack README and installed skill; no prepared live plan.
cases.expected: Discover/remap/adopt two supplied groups; first three cards stay in one engineering context.

cases.setup: Use legacy Markdown in place of JSON, with the same six raw cards.
cases.expected: Normalize once and preserve both groups without a disposable planner.

cases.setup: The small later target has no plan or RFC.
cases.expected: One responsible engineer plans then implements; no invented RFC or planning generation.

cases.setup: Each raw issue labels itself Milestone M1 etc.
cases.expected: Canonical grouping controls; text headings never directly select new generations.

cases.setup: Only first card in a dependency chain is Ready.
cases.expected: Plan through relevant in-scope successors; claim each when eligible.

cases.setup: Remap IDs, move an issue lane, restart coordinator using only live RFC linkage.
cases.expected: Find adopted plan with stable milestone IDs; no original ZIP replay or regrouping.

cases.setup: Finish DEMO-0001 with real evidence while DEMO-0002/3 remain.
cases.expected: Stay within add-and-list; no completed milestone or fresh producer.

cases.setup: All three card records claim Done but public integration evidence is missing.
cases.expected: Milestone completion remains unresolved; no spawn on label alone.

cases.setup: Accept only AC01/AC02 of DEMO-0100.
cases.expected: Accept selected milestone scope only; keep card and remainder open.

cases.setup: Form concrete milestones for remaining AC03/AC04.
cases.expected: Preserve existing first group; transfer exactly the unplanned obligations.

cases.setup: User authorizes only DEMO-0001 from a broader supplied plan.
cases.expected: Bind explicit subset; do not implement other cards or close source milestone/RFC.

cases.setup: A required unfinished prerequisite is outside selected user scope.
cases.expected: Report dependency; no automatic scope/permission expansion.

cases.setup: Plan exists with malformed JSON or unsupported version.
cases.expected: Report invalid/unsupported input, not absent-plan fallback.

cases.setup: Two distinct applicable candidates without authoritative selection.
cases.expected: Report candidates/conflict; no arbitrary filename wins.

cases.setup: Manifest points outside authorized input root or through an unsupported link.
cases.expected: Refuse unsafe discovery/adoption, preserve unrelated bytes.

cases.setup: Existing adopted ID has different content or interrupted link publication.
cases.expected: Detect/reconcile idempotently; no last-writer-wins overwrite.

cases.setup: Native turn ends before current milestone is complete.
cases.expected: Resume exact producer with new dispatch when supported; unsupported stays explicit.

cases.setup: First substantial outcome is accepted; second is eligible.
cases.expected: Normally fresh integrator, carrying actual next milestone and boundary reason.

cases.setup: Small adjacent authorized outcome benefits from current useful context.
cases.expected: Explicit related continuation allowed with renewed authority; no unconditional reset.

cases.setup: Current producer becomes unavailable before completing outcome.
cases.expected: Account for writer/children/commands then transfer unfinished obligations; never false completion.

cases.setup: Return arrives while child command active; then user cancels.
cases.expected: Wait/reconcile old effects; cancellation forbids automatic successor.

cases.setup: Duplicate native terminal or late obsolete result arrives.
cases.expected: Consume once and reject stale binding; no extra spawn/acceptance.

cases.setup: Only unrelated future milestone definition changes.
cases.expected: Unaffected bound current result remains usable; no artificial reset.

cases.setup: Current source criterion changes even with identical plan JSON.
cases.expected: Renew affected obligation binding; old evidence cannot satisfy new requirements.

cases.setup: Required human/native criterion pending, independent eligible scope remains.
cases.expected: Preserve exact pending candidate and obligations; independently scoped continuation only.

cases.setup: User asks only status, usage diagnosis or read-only review.
cases.expected: No plan creation/import or implementation-family startup.
